registration: Written before computing these comparison results; internal, not externally preregistered
scope: 16 synthetic pairs, each corrected/uncorrected and Placidus/wholeSign: 64 charts; fixed boundary cases and seed 20261102
referenceAssembly: Separately installed pyswisseph 2.10.3.2, arithmetic coordinate/UT1 means and Newton correction of MC; SDK uses bisection. Same Swiss algorithms, so this checks independent assembly and integration, not independent astronomical models.
referencePositions: Skyfield 1.49 with NASA/JPL DE440s, apparent geocentric ecliptic-of-date positions at SDK-reported TT; no Swiss calculations for these positions
referenceAngles: Skyfield apparent sidereal time and true obliquity, analytic MC and ascendant at SDK-reported UT1; independent from Swiss angle code, shared UT1 input
timeConvention: UT1 mean as documented by this SDK, not a claim that all commercial Davison software uses this time scale
failurePolicy: Keep every case and mismatch; no tolerance changes or sample exclusion after results; exit nonzero on any mismatch
limits: Same assistant wrote implementation and verification, not an independent human audit
Not a direct numerical comparison to Astro.com charts
Shared Swiss core for assembly, houses and speeds
Shared SDK TT for JPL position comparison does not independently validate UTC conversion
No whole-domain guarantee for 1800..2399 or platform/binding packaging
